component.name: QuickSwitch Audio
component.summary: Switch audio outputs and control their volume

description.p: QuickSwitch Audio lets you choose between speakers, headphones, USB audio, Bluetooth devices, and HDMI outputs available to your desktop audio server.
Choose the outputs to include in a switching cycle, adjust the current output’s volume, and use a custom desktop shortcut to switch with the window closed.

ul.li: Discover playback devices and available ports automatically
Remember your output cycle when devices are unplugged
Choose a light or dark theme
Request background activity and startup at login

description.p: Add a Flatpak build with bundled audio tools and desktop background integration.
